# Institute on the Environment

> IonE is University of Minnesota's interdisciplinary research institute discovering solutions to the world's environmental challenges through sustainability research, leadership development, and community engagement.

The Institute on the Environment (IonE) at the University of Minnesota Twin Cities conducts cutting-edge environmental research across climate change, energy transition, food systems, and ecological economics. IonE offers graduate and undergraduate programs, postdoctoral fellowships, and experiential learning opportunities while advancing diversity, equity, and inclusion in environmental leadership.

## Key Topics

- sustainability
- environmental research
- climate change
- energy transition
- leadership development
- graduate programs
- postdoctoral fellowships
- food systems
- community engagement
- diversity and inclusion
- ecological economics
- experiential education
- interdisciplinary research
- mitigation and adaptation
- renewable energy
